The cottage

Character in every beam, and the dale from every window

West Close Cottage is a converted split-level, single-storey farm building worked in local stone. It has a wealth of character — a floor-to-ceiling stone fireplace, wooden beams and a galleried landing — and the lounge, kitchen and conservatory all look out over the dales.

4 + cot
Sleeps
2
Bedrooms
2
Dogs welcome

You enter through a light and airy conservatory into the impressive lounge, where the stone fireplace houses a log-burning stove beneath exposed roof trusses and a railed gallery. Two bedrooms open off the lounge — one with a double bed and fitted wardrobe, the other with two singles and a dressing chest — with a lobby and modern bathroom (bath, shower, washbasin and WC) adjoining.

Three steps down from the lounge is a large, well-equipped fitted kitchen and dining room with fresh, modern cabinets. Outside there's a secure, floodlit parking area to one side and the cottage's own patio with garden furniture.

Location

From the door

Melmerby sits on the north side of Coverdale, a quiet side-dale off Wensleydale, inside the Yorkshire Dales National Park.

Walking

Many local walks from the door, and easy access to the extensive Yorkshire Dales walking network.

Cycling

On the Yorkshire Dales Cycleway. Secure bike storage at the cottage.

How we run the cottages

Warm, quiet and a little lighter on the dale

  • Biomass boiler. Both cottages are heated by an environmentally friendly biomass boiler — and heating is included in the price.
  • EV charging. A type 2 socket for each cottage, each on its own meter.
  • New double glazing throughout, plus a recent redecoration, new carpets in the living areas and new kitchen flooring.
  • Kinder products. Environmentally friendly cleaning products from Splosh where we can, and recycled, plastic-free loo roll from Who Gives A Crap.
